diagnosed: Research agent dies on EVERY escalated run with 'Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use \'*\''. Root cause: scout/coverage-critic escalate via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN, so the triggering actor is github-actions[bot]; claude-code-action@v1 refuses bot actors unless allowed_bots is set, which none of the three action steps in research-agent.yml configure. Scheduled runs (human actor) still work, which is why research-agent commits exist. Confirmed across runs 38282851957-era: 38244621855, 38189146055, 38132855793, 38067435631 (10-06..10-12).
notes: REAL breakage found but the only correct fix is in a protected automation path (.github/workflows/research-agent.yml). The protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook BLOCKS this unattended CI agent from authoring any .github/workflows/** change (exit 2: 'A human must author changes to these files'), so no PR could be opened. No non-protected alternative exists: any `gh workflow run` dispatch produces a bot actor, so allowed_bots must live in the workflow. A human must apply this one-line fix.

OWNER FIX (research escalations): in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml add `allowed_bots: "*"` to the `with:` block of all three `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (standard Opus 4.8, deep Fable 5, deep Opus 4.8 fallback), alongside claude_code_oauth_token. This re-enables scout/coverage-critic -> research escalations (dead since ~10-06).

SECONDARY breakage (also protected, human-only): Visual QA agent fails recurrently with 'Claude reported a successful result after 53 turns, exceeding the configured maximum of 40' (run 38282851957, 10-12). The agent completes its work but the configured --max-turns is too low for the 3-width screenshot+analysis+log pass. OWNER FIX: raise --max-turns in .github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml from 40 to ~80.

NOT bugs (ignored per prompt): two Static data pipeline failures (10-05, 10-07) were transient GitHub Pages infra blips ('No artifacts named github-pages'/githubstatus.com); publish-freshness.json is currently 'fresh' (0h lag) so deploys are landing. Usage is green (session 1%/week 2%), so the agent failures are not quota.
HEALTHY: npm test 1544/1544 pass; validate-events.js 0 errors (warnings only); build-alert ok (140 events); no stale-retained fetcher stamps; no high-severity coverage gaps.
